questions.question: Can any strategy receive capital or a reward now?
questions.answer: No. The committed gate ledger has no validated candidate; quote evidence and prospective replication are missing.
questions.missing: Authenticated entry/close offers, complete trial registry, untouched forward results.
questions.discovery: Capture operator-owned timestamped offers and prospectively log every signal, including no-bets.
questions.gate: All eight gates plus prospective replication; no automatic wagering.

questions.question: Do we have independent fair lines?
questions.answer: A walk-forward market-free model exists; its estimates are research outputs, not official prices.
questions.missing: A full official historical outcome census and uncertainty/calibration evidence.
questions.discovery: Reconcile game IDs and results to NFL Game Centers; evaluate paired held-out calibration without moving the test window.
questions.gate: Verify observations before publishing numeric claims.

questions.question: Were historical odds actually executable at the time?
questions.answer: Not established by community archive hashes.
questions.missing: Operator, jurisdiction, offer time, line, price, limits, status and settlement rule version.
questions.discovery: Obtain a permitted operator-owned quote archive; retain receipt time and raw response hashes.
questions.gate: Unverified prices stay blank; do not infer missing offers.

questions.question: Does an injury designation establish who plays?
questions.answer: No. The official report supplies injury/practice/game-status fields, not a complete confirmed lineup.
questions.missing: Official inactive lists and pregame participation/starting announcements for each game.
questions.discovery: Capture NFL and club reports with observation time and publication time kept separate.
questions.gate: No default healthy/active label for an absent or blank field.

questions.question: Is a second-, third- or fourth-string replacement confirmed?
questions.answer: Published club chart cells are recorded separately; a chart does not confirm a game-time promotion.
questions.missing: Player identity joins, effective date, explicit replacement announcement and eligible roster.
questions.discovery: Reconcile chart, transactions, game-day inactives and named starting announcements; quarantine conflicts.
questions.gate: Do not turn column order into a confirmed starter or replacement.

questions.question: Can we quantify an offensive or defensive deficiency?
questions.answer: No verified player-level impact estimate is supplied by an injury or chart alone.
questions.missing: As-of snap shares, assignment/coverage context, opponent-adjusted performance and uncertainty.
questions.discovery: Test position-group availability interactions versus the base model on chronological holdouts; include offensive and defensive units.
questions.gate: Require incremental out-of-sample value and calibration; leave point adjustment blank meanwhile.

questions.question: Which correlation is needed for a parlay or prop combo?
questions.answer: Continuous player-stat correlation and binary leg-win dependence are not interchangeable.
questions.missing: Aligned player-game observations, exact thresholds, common game context and sample uncertainty.
questions.discovery: Estimate both marginal and joint probabilities on held-out games; bootstrap by game/week and test regime stability.
questions.gate: No independent-leg product for same-game pricing without validation; missing correlations blank.

questions.question: Can a positive simulated parlay ROI justify entry?
questions.answer: No. The current tickets are research simulations, not authenticated operator offers.
questions.missing: Joint quote, leg eligibility, void/push rules, offer timestamp and limits.
questions.discovery: Compare same-time executable singles and offered joint tickets under the specific operator rules.
questions.gate: Pass all gates at ticket level after costs and adverse-price stress.

questions.question: Can player-prop combinations be priced and rewarded?
questions.answer: Research prop calculations exist; verified prop and joint SGP prices do not.
questions.missing: Official player outcomes, participation, role, exact market thresholds and offered joint prices.
questions.discovery: Join official player/game evidence to timestamped operator offers, including inactive and voided tickets.
questions.gate: No prop ROI, reward or invented joint quote from missing inputs.

questions.question: Can luck be removed completely?
questions.answer: No. Existing block-bootstrap, multiplicity, power and stability gates reduce false discoveries; they do not eliminate randomness.
questions.missing: Complete exploratory search history and untouched prospective replication.
questions.discovery: Freeze all strategy versions, thresholds, trial count and evaluation dates before a forward paper contest.
questions.gate: Reward eligibility requires independent replication, not a high raw ROI rank.

questions.question: Is this a live league-wide injury service?
questions.answer: No. This page is a dated two-club evidence sample; the read-only monitor archives fresh source pages separately.
questions.missing: All-club coverage, extraction validation, effective dates, freshness SLA and recovery procedures.
questions.discovery: Expand source coverage only after parser fixtures, identity reconciliation, failure alerts and review of snapshot changes.
questions.gate: Never label the sample current beyond its retrieval date or present collection as verified extraction.

questions.question: What decisions remain for the reviewer?
questions.answer: Recommendations are proposed, not approved. The site is read-only and needs no data entry to inspect.
questions.missing: Permitted data-access terms, deployment refresh policy, contest funding and legal eligibility.
questions.discovery: Compare the alternatives and evidence gates in the suggestions queue; authorize implementation only after documented review.
questions.gate: No purchase, monetary prize, account linking or bet execution is authorized here.

suggestions.title: Timestamped quote provenance
suggestions.recommendation: Prefer operator-owned permitted captures over another community archive.
suggestions.alternative: A second archive is cheaper but cannot prove executable offers.
suggestions.acceptance: Validate terms, timestamps, limits and raw hashes; reject future quotes.
suggestions.risk: Access terms, historical coverage and permitted cost remain unknown.

suggestions.title: League-wide injury and lineup collector
suggestions.recommendation: Expand the read-only two-club pilot into official report, transactions and inactive snapshots.
suggestions.alternative: A news aggregator offers breadth but weakens the official-source requirement.
suggestions.acceptance: Fixture-tested extraction, all-club coverage, identity joins, publication-time evidence and stale-source alerts.
suggestions.benefit: Enables documented starter/backup availability without guessing.
suggestions.risk: Pilot only; no live league-wide coverage or confirmed promotion feed.

suggestions.title: Position-group replacement scenarios
suggestions.recommendation: Evaluate offensive line, QB/receiver and defensive front/secondary availability interactions as separate hypotheses.
suggestions.alternative: Use a team-level absence count as a transparent baseline, not an assumed impact.
suggestions.acceptance: Verified roles/snaps, no post-kickoff features, incremental held-out calibration and multiplicity correction.
suggestions.benefit: Tests whether backup exposure adds predictive information.
suggestions.risk: No quantified deficiency or point adjustment is currently verified.

suggestions.title: Joint-outcome simulation
suggestions.recommendation: Fit a calibrated shared game/usage simulation and compare with empirical joint events.
suggestions.alternative: An independent-leg product is only a diagnostic baseline.
suggestions.acceptance: Observed marginals and joint frequencies, game-block confidence intervals, tail checks and offered joint prices.
suggestions.benefit: Avoids treating all correlated legs as independent.
suggestions.risk: Sparse prop samples and missing joint quotes may keep this research-only.

suggestions.title: Prospective paper competition
suggestions.recommendation: Freeze entrants, trial registry and walk-forward evaluation before an untouched paper period.
suggestions.alternative: Ranking historical raw ROI is simpler but selection-biased.
suggestions.acceptance: All gate outcomes recorded; no reward without complete provenance and independent replication.
suggestions.benefit: Separates research ranking from reward eligibility.
suggestions.risk: No funded prize pool; reward amount and eligibility remain unset.

suggestions.title: Evidence-first decision screen
suggestions.recommendation: Keep the readiness questions, source dates, blanks and blockers adjacent to leaderboard links.
suggestions.alternative: A headline-only performance dashboard obscures missing evidence.
suggestions.acceptance: Every row linked to evidence/context; distinguish observed fact from proposal; stale snapshots visibly dated.
suggestions.benefit: Makes missing information reviewable before model changes.
suggestions.risk: This review surface is implemented; substantive model proposals remain unapproved.

suggestions.title: Full outcome and settlement census
suggestions.recommendation: Reconcile every model game and settlement to official Game Centers before promoting metrics.
suggestions.alternative: A small score sample detects defects but cannot certify the full archive.
suggestions.acceptance: Exact game joins, blank unknown fields, row-level links and discrepancy quarantine.
suggestions.benefit: Expands verification beyond the inherited sample.
suggestions.risk: Official source access and historical completeness are not yet established.

suggestions.title: Calibrated abstention and uncertainty
suggestions.recommendation: Compare uncertainty-aware no-bet rules with the existing frozen thresholds in separate forward trials.
suggestions.alternative: Increasing stake on the top raw estimate compounds estimation error.
suggestions.acceptance: Pre-register thresholds, no-bet records, calibration bins, stress tests and incremental held-out benefit.
suggestions.benefit: Tests selective participation rather than forcing a pick.
suggestions.risk: No numeric uncertainty cutoff or stake recommendation is approved.
